lead_raw_text:
The structure of FeSbO4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmmm (No. 15), with a 12-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors (2.08–2.14 Å), while Sb centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors (2.78–2.93 Å). Corner-sharing between Fe octahedra is observed, along with face-sharing between Fe octahedra and Sb 12-vertex polyhedra and between Fe and O polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
